WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.SEX,
        COUNT(*) as test_count
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX != ''
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(test_count) as total,
        AVG(test_count) as avg_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT 
    sc.SEX,
    sc.test_count,
    sc.test_count * 1.0 / st.total as fraction_of_total,
    sc.test_count - st.avg_count as above_average
FROM sex_counts sc
CROSS JOIN stats st
WHERE sc.test_count > st.avg_count
